pages.title: Skyward Slam
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Mace$(br2)§lEffect: §r A mace hit launches the target upward, then deals a second "aftershock" hit when the target lands.$(br2)Launch velocity: 0.8 + 0.2 × level$(br)Aftershock damage: 3 + 3 × level$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br)Players in Creative mode are not launched.
